feeds.title: The Pre-Dental Guide Blog
feeds.description: We specialize in offering advice to get you admitted into dental school. This is a guide written by dental students, for future dental students. Our goal in writing this blog is to assist you in becoming a better applicant for dental or graduate school.

feeds.title: Pre-Dental Advice Blog
feeds.description: Are you wondering how to get into dental school? Learn from dental students and dentists through our blog about their experiences. We feature dentists, dental students, and soon-to-be dental students as they share the things they wish they had known as pre-dental students.

feeds.title: UC Davis Pre-Dental Society Blog
feeds.description: The UC Davis Pre-Dental Society is a student-run club at the University of California, Davis. As a group of enthusiastic pre-dental students, PDS is motivated to providing a positive environment for UC Davis students who are interested in dentistry.

feeds.title: Dr. Michael Krochak's Pre-Dental Scholarship Blog
feeds.description: Get tips and advice for Dental aspirant students about the application, selecting dental schools and more. We are expert cosmetic dentists committed to improving our patients health, appearance and self-esteem.

feeds.title: Pre-Medical and Pre-Dental Advising Office Blog
feeds.description: The University of Connecticut's Pre-Medical and Pre-Dental Advising Office provides resources and advising to UConn students and alumni interested in pursuing careers in the health professions.
